claims.text: The FBI raided Raj Rajaratnam's Galleon Group hedge fund in October 2009
Rajat Gupta was charged with insider trading by the SEC on April 6, 2010
Gupta was convicted on four counts of insider trading on May 24, 2011
Gupta was sentenced to two years in prison and fined $5 million on June 15, 2012

outcome.summary: Rajat Gupta was convicted of insider trading in 2011 and sentenced to two years in prison. He served his sentence and was released in 2016. The case damaged the reputation of McKinsey & Company, where Gupta had been Managing Director, and highlighted the need for stronger board-level insider trading controls.

title: Rajat Gupta convicted in insider trading case
trigger: Rajat Gupta, former Managing Director of McKinsey and board member of Goldman Sachs and Procter & Gamble, was convicted of insider trading for passing confidential board information to hedge fund manager Raj Rajaratnam.
